title: Branch locations, hours and holidays - support procedure
content: The fictional Central Demo Branch is located at 10 Example Avenue, Demo City and opens Monday to Friday from 9 AM to 4 PM under the configured directory. Holiday and specialist availability must be checked with the demo branch record; these are not real-bank details.
